sources.title: Microduck - A tiny biped robot you can teach new tricks | Pollen Robotics
sources.snippet: Microduck is a 25 cm biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, LiDAR and a grasping beak. Playable out of the box, and its open-source stack lets you train new behaviours in simulation and run them on the robot. Pre-order at $399.

sources.snippet: Every main task has a Backlash twin that trains on a model with ±1° of gear play (2° total) in series with each of the 14 servo joints: insert -Backlash before MicroDuck in the task id, e.g. Mjlab-Velocity-Flat-Backlash-MicroDuck. The backlash is modeled properly for sim2real: each servo gets an unactuated passive_<joint>_backlash hinge, and because the real encoder sits on the output side ...
